title: Dependent Parents in a Disability Compensation Replacement Payment
content:
The parent additions in a replacement of a returned Disability Compensation payment are as many parent additions as the parent maximum of 2 when the award records at least 2 dependent parents, one parent addition when it records exactly one dependent parent, and nothing when it records none.

The dependent parents recorded are the parent additions on the award less the parent removals, and every month a replacement covers counts the parents so recorded. Each parent addition is the 100 percent tier's parent addition of 176.88 when the award's decision history shows individual unemployability granted, and the award's own tier's parent addition otherwise.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (90% Combined Rating), no individual unemployability)**

| Dependent parents recorded | Parent additions | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | None | Nothing |
| 1 | One | 159.19 |
| 2 | Two (the maximum) | 318.38 |
| 3 additions recorded, none removed | Two (the maximum) | 318.38 |
